'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Operation Aspides]]
***[[German Navy]] warship [[German frigate Hessen|''Hessen'']] shoots down two drones launched by [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] forces in [[Yemen]] as part of the [[European Union]]'s mission to protect [[Freight transport|international shipping]] in the [[Red Sea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/german-warship-part-eu-red-sea-mission-shoots-down-two-drones-2024-02-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***The [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] withdraws from the villages of [[Sieverne, Pokrovsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast|Sieverne]] and [[Stepove, Donetsk Oblast|Stepove]] near [[Avdiivka]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], following the announcement of its withdrawal from the nearby village of [[Lastochkyne]] on February 26. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-withdraws-two-villages-near-avdiivka-military-says-2024-02-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Japan]]ese [[technology company]] [[Sony]] announces it will cut 900 jobs across its global workforce and has also proposed the closure of [[London Studio]] as part of the restructuring. [https://sonyinteractive.com/en/news/blog/difficult-news-about-our-workforce/?sf271923331=1 (Sony Interactive Entertainment press release)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Thirty-one people are killed and ten more injured after a bus en route from [[Mali]] to [[Burkina Faso]] crashes on a road in [[Koumantou]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-31-dead-transport-accident-280eaa950e461c4e0fa119a3df6b1511 (AP)]
* Multiple tornadoes spawn from a very rare late season tornado outbreak. [[Tornadoes of 2024#February 27%E2%80%9328 (United States)|(February 27-28, 2024 Tornadoes)]]
*Two people are killed in [[Conakry]], [[Guinea]], during protests related to an ongoing [[general strike|nationwide strike]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/two-killed-guinea-unrest-linked-nationwide-strike-2024-02-27/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Smokehouse Creek Fire]] in the [[Texas panhandle]] continues to spread, with almost 200,000 acres currently on fire. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/02/27/weather/texas-fires-canadian-smokehouse-creek/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[1974 Mitsubishi Heavy Industries bombing]]
**The identity of a deceased man is confirmed by a DNA test to be [[Satoshi Kirishima]], who participated in a 1974 bombing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-68412672 (BBC News)]
*In the [[Netherlands]], the [[Marengo trial]] concludes after six years. Of the 17 prosecuted people, three people, including [[Ridouan Taghi]] and [[Saïd Razzouki]], are sentenced to [[life imprisonment]] for their role in ten murders. [https://nos.nl/collectie/13809/artikel/2510559-levenslang-voor-ridouan-taghi-en-twee-anderen-in-marengo-proces (NOS)]
*[[Russia]]n [[human rights]] activist [[Oleg Orlov]] is sentenced to 2 and a half years in prison for "repeatedly discrediting" the [[Russian military]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-orlov-nobel-sentenced-8539517d8b2c846706607584ba5f9bbb (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Republican Party presidential primaries]], [[2024 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[Michigan]] holds its [[2024 Michigan Republican presidential primary|Republican]] and [[2024 Michigan Democratic presidential primary|Democratic primaries]]. Former [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] and incumbent President [[Joe Biden]] are the respective winners.
